summary: Madera Community Hospital detected suspicious activity in its computer network on May 29, 2025, and discovered that an unauthorized external party gained access for approximately two days in late May 2025. A forensic investigation completed in June 2025 initially found no evidence of file theft, but subsequent developments led the hospital to believe files were acquired from a portion of the network. A data-review firm analyzed the potentially impacted files in April 2026, determining they contained personal information and protected health information (specific data elements listed in template fields). The hospital stated it found no evidence the data was released publicly or shared, and notified law enforcement.
